_meta.description: LVIS Group library data used by Lender Finder. Each entry's `policyUrl` is that institution's OCLC ILL policies page — use it for 'View OCLC policies' / 'Load policies from OCLC' instead of running a symbol search.

fields.branch: Library/branch name when distinct from institution
fields.state: Two-letter US state code (null for non-US)
fields.location: Raw location string from the export
fields.copiesDaysToRespond: Stated turnaround for copy requests, in days
fields.loansDaysToRespond: Stated turnaround for loan requests, in days
fields.copiesFees: Fee string for copies (varies — may be a range or 'XXX' currency)
fields.policyUrl: Direct link to this institution in the OCLC ILL Policies Directory
fields.institutionId: OCLC DILL institutionId parsed from policyUrl
fields.lat: Approximate latitude (city centroid from US postal data)
fields.lng: Approximate longitude (city centroid from US postal data)
